section_roles.related_work: \b(?:related work|prior work|literature review|state of the art|обзор)\b

linking.note: The linking layer (lctrend.linking). skipped_section_roles: chunks of these section_roles (from the heading, or a heading that opens the chunk) never reach the model; a document made only of them is read whole. known_concepts: registry concepts a packet names (lexical) or resembles (cosine of a chunk and a cached concept vector), sent as reference names.

similar.note: SIMILAR_TO (lctrend similar-rebuild): mutual k-nearest concepts of one kind family by cosine of stored vectors; computed edges without evidence, excluded from structural graph metrics.

reconcile.note: After publication the document's accepted claims are compared with the graph's (lctrend.linking.reconcile): one slot = predicate + concepts in roles + normalized qualifiers; CORROBORATES / CONTRADICTS link claims of other works; SHARES_CONTEXT_WITH links technologies stated in min_shared identical contexts (partners other than countries and domains). reconcile-claims rebuilds the whole layer.

pdf_pipeline_note: Docling pipeline options. OCR and the table-structure model were on by default: on 2026-09-29 five of six workers waited on the single PDF converter while it ran RapidOCR on digital OpenAlex PDFs, and the result tables are dropped by section selection anyway. Scanned PDFs without a text layer give no text with do_ocr false.

openalex_fulltext.bibliography_heading: ^\s*(?:\d+\.?\s*)?(?:references(?: and notes)?|bibliography|literature cited|works cited|cited literature|список (?:использованн(?:ой|ых) )?(?:литературы|источников)|библиографический список|литература|источники)\s*[:.]?\s*$
openalex_fulltext.sections_note: A PDF is read by sections, not whole: on 2026-09-29 a full text cost 48 model calls on average (306 chunks) against 1.5 for an abstract. Chunks of the roles below (section_roles, from headings) are kept in this priority up to max_chunks, in document order; without recognized headings the first head_chunks and last tail_chunks are read (introduction and conclusion). Authors and affiliations come from OpenAlex metadata, never from the PDF. max_chunks 0 reads everything.
openalex_fulltext.hosts_note: PDF links are tried open repositories first and bot-walled publishers last: on 2026-09-29 only 19 of 67 attempted PDFs downloaded; MDPI, Hindawi, SAGE, ACM and ScienceDirect answer 403 or a challenge page whatever the User-Agent, while 192 of 308 works also had a copy on arXiv, PMC or a repository, 27 of them not first in OpenAlex order.

graph_context.semantic_note: search_graph unites the full-text match with a vector search over evidence chunks (chunks cited by accepted claims) at cosine >= semantic_min_score, so a query finds context in another language or wording.
